name: WhatsApp
summary: Businesses reach WhatsApp users through Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), which bills per delivered message and only allows free-form replies inside a 24-hour customer service window. Since January 2026 Meta's terms bar general-purpose AI assistants from the Business API, while customer-service bots remain allowed. Unofficial libraries such as Baileys drive a personal account instead, against WhatsApp's terms.
facts: Official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API); unofficial bridges exist
Per delivered message, by category and country (since 2025-07-01)
1,000 free per number per month, then billed (from 2026-10-01)
Free-form replies only within 24 hours of the user's last message
General-purpose AI assistants barred from the Business API (from 2026-01-15)
goodFor: Reaching users in markets where WhatsApp dominates
watchOut: General-purpose assistants are restricted by Meta's terms
Per-message costs, including service replies from October 2026
